meaning:
ῥαβδίζω
(ῥάβδος), [in LXX: Jdg.6:11 Rut.2:17 (חָבַט) * ;]
to beat with a rod: Act.16:22, 2Co.11:25.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: The multitude rose up together against them and the magistrates tore their clothes from them, then commanded them to be beaten with rods.
Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.
